For the Petitioners: Mr. Kaushik Sarkhel, Advocate For the State : Mr. A. K. Trivedi, A.C. to S.C.-VII 04/ Dated:-08.11.2023 Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioner no.1 is the maternal brother-in-law (mamera Bhai), petitioner no. 2 is the maternal brother (mousera bhai),
petitioner no. 3 is brother-in-law (mamera Bhai), petitioner no. 4 is the brother-in-law of the respondent no.2, petitioner no. 5 is the villager and friend of the husband of the respondent no.2,
petitioner no. 6 is the uncle-in-law, petitioner no. 7 is the brother-in-law of the respondent no.2.

He submits that police has investigated the matter and chargesheet has been submitted only against the husband of the respondent no.2 and there is no chargesheet against these petitioners however the learned court differing the final form has taken cognizance against these petitioners.

He submits that there is general and omnibus allegations against the petitioners who are not residing there and are distant relatives, have been made accused in this case lodged under section 498A I.P.C. and Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. Issue notice upon the respondent no.2 under registered cover with A/D as well as by ordinary process for which requisites etc. must be filed within one week after Dipawali vacation.
3. Let it appear on 03.01.2024.
